# High School Credit Recovery Goal Sheet

Subject: Intervention
Grade band: 9-12
Resource type: Goal Sheet
NYS framework label: NYS Learning Standards and local MTSS planning

## Short Description
A supportive goal sheet for tracking missing work, priority standards, and weekly progress.

## Alignment Note
Supports intervention planning, progress monitoring, and student ownership of academic recovery.

## Classroom Use Case
Use in advisory, academic lab, or intervention meetings with students and families.

## Preview Content
- Priority work this week
- Barrier and support
- Friday progress check

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
